ancestry.changeling: a human face with slightly sharp features and mismatched eyes, one brown or blue and the other green, violet or amber, and a pale streak in dark hair
ancestry.duskwalker: a human face with pale grey-tinged skin, ash-white hair and pale grey eyes, a solemn, quietly watchful face
ancestry.dwarf: a sturdy build with a thick neck and broad shoulders, deep-set eyes, a broad nose, thick hair and small rounded human ears
ancestry.elf: a slender build, long pointed ears, large almond-shaped eyes, high cheekbones and fine, ageless features
ancestry.gnome: a small pointed face with large expressive eyes, small pointed ears and brightly coloured hair such as copper-red, green or violet
ancestry.goblin: a large head for its body, big pointed ears, red eyes, a wide mouth with small sharp teeth and green or grey skin
ancestry.halfling: a grown adult's face with mature features, round and open, curly hair, slightly pointed ears and bright eyes
ancestry.hobgoblin: a lean build with broad shoulders, a hairless head, pointed ears, narrow dark eyes and grey skin with a faint blue tint
ancestry.human: an ordinary human face, memorable, with a strongly individual nose, jaw and brow
ancestry.kobold: a small wiry draconic humanoid of a monstrous people, with a person's hunched posture and a cunning, wary expression: scaled skin of one colour such as red, blue, green, black, white or brass, a short blunt dragon-like snout, slit-pupilled eyes, a smooth tapering skull and clawed hands
ancestry.leshy: a plant creature with a body of twisted roots and bark and dark knot-hole eyes
ancestry.nephilim: a human face with one subtle otherworldly trait, such as golden eyes, two small horns, a few feathers in the hair or skin with a faint metallic sheen
ancestry.orc: a strong broad-shouldered build, green or grey skin, a heavy brow, pointed ears, a square jaw and lower tusks
ancestry.ratfolk: a gaunt ratlike humanoid of a monstrous people, with a person's hunched posture and a sharp, wary expression: mangy grey-brown fur, a narrow whiskered muzzle, long yellowed front incisors, ragged round ears and small dark eyes

ancestry_dress.changeling: slightly mismatched clothes with small charms sewn on, knotted cords, a sprig of dried herbs and a small bone token on a string
ancestry_dress.duskwalker: plain grey and ash-coloured cloth like mourning dress, a small lantern pin, a faded black ribbon tied about the arm
ancestry_dress.dwarf: heavy durable gear: riveted iron, bronze fittings stamped with angular runes, thick stitched leather, knotwork engraved on the buckles
ancestry_dress.elf: light, finely made gear: fitted layered silk and soft tooled leather with leaf and vine patterns, small pale silver clasps
ancestry_dress.gnome: colourful clothes in clashing patterned fabrics, a few dangling trinkets, one odd homemade brass gadget
ancestry_dress.goblin: scavenged, ill-fitting gear: patched rags and mismatched scraps tied together with twine, a dented piece of armour slightly too big
ancestry_dress.halfling: practical homespun clothes: a wool waistcoat with brass buttons, neatly patched sleeves, a travelling cloak
ancestry_dress.hobgoblin: neat, uniform military gear: lacquered plates in tidy rows, crimson cords, close-fitting and well polished
ancestry_dress.human: plain well-worn travelling clothes and gear of ordinary make, scuffed from the road
ancestry_dress.kobold: crude scavenged tribal gear: rough hide and scale wraps, bright stones and coins strung on cords, dragon-shaped symbols daubed in paint, a brass ring through the snout
ancestry_dress.leshy: very little clothing: a few woven grass and vine wraps, gear tied on with bark and leaf bindings, moss growing over any metal
ancestry_dress.nephilim: fine, plain garments with a small sun or flame motif embroidered at the collar
ancestry_dress.orc: hide and fur, rough-forged iron, bone and tusk ornaments, a few painted bands across the arms
ancestry_dress.ratfolk: layered grimy rags and a frayed hooded cloak, many small pouches hung on cords, bits of salvaged brass and wire, a filthy scarf wound around the neck

ancestry_form.leshy_fungus: a mushroom person: a broad speckled mushroom cap for a head, gills beneath its rim shading a pale fungal face, a few small toadstools sprouting on the shoulders
ancestry_form.leshy_gourd: a head that is a ridged gourd with a carved-wood face, a curling vine stem and a few leaves sprouting from its top
ancestry_form.leshy_leaf: a seed-pod head with a carved-wood face, a crown of broad leaves growing from the scalp, a few small flowers among them

ancestry_sex.dwarf_female: a woman with a round face, smooth cheeks and a bare chin, thick hair pinned up in coiled braids
